state_definitions.EARLY: participation is abnormal but price is not yet extended; hypothesis only
state_definitions.DEVELOPING: multiple independent participation/structure signals are strengthening
state_definitions.CONFIRMED: strong participation plus structure/derivatives evidence; still conditional
state_definitions.LATE: move is already advanced or breakout is too close to current price

method: Full Binance USDT spot universe from exchangeInfo
24h ticker breadth for every live symbol
1h volume acceleration and short-term structure for top 120 unusual/liquid assets
funding and open-interest context for top 80
extension penalty to reduce late pump chasing
policy: Discovery is not a prediction guarantee.
Only EARLY/DEVELOPING candidates may enter the early-discovery lane.
CONFIRMED still requires a verified trigger/invalidation before directional publishing.
LATE and EXHAUSTED candidates are excluded from early-mover publishing.
Order flow/funding/OI are context, not proof of whale activity or future direction.
